confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from crowdsourced guides and venue listings with inconsistent dates, some several years old, so they are rough. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation prices were searched or checked against live listings. The FX observation (18 Nov 2026, 0.6720) came from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not confirmed by opening the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close comparable city was used. Food and drink bounds come from Mombasa-specific price guides and Nyali bar and restaurant listings, cross-checked against each other. Accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Mombasa's coastal tourist market.
